app_name: InaPintar Tax Knowledge Hub & AI Contextual Assistant
archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) for Enterprise Tax Practitioners

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-slate-200/60 shadow-lg shadow-slate-900/5

key_features: Putusan Pajak Detail View with metadata (Nomor Putusan, Tahun, Jenis Pajak, Majelis Hakim, Amar Putusan)
Full text document reader with search, highlight, and copy citation
Interactive AI Contextual Assistant panel on the side powered by GPT-5.6 Terra & Gemini 3 Flash
Multi-source search & filter across 81,000+ tax judgments and regulations
Dataset/file upload simulation to load custom tax rulings
Public source public data integration & citation linking

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA and WCAG AA compliant (>4.5:1 for normal text, >3:1 for large text)
accessibility.interactive_elements: Explicit focus rings and hover states on all buttons and inputs with data-testid attributes

universal_guidelines: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes
Distinct typography hierarchy with tight letter spacing on headings
